tools.description: Use this after start_site_audit to check whether the audit has finished. Takes the audit_id. Returns status (queued, running, completed, failed or canceled), pages crawled so far, the page limit, and any notes or error text. tools.description: Use this once get_audit_status shows completed. Takes the audit_id and an optional top_n (1 to 25, default 10). Returns the issues ranked by likely impact, each with the number of affected pages, example URLs and a plain-English fix, plus a list of what was checked, what was not checked, and a note
